policyAmendment: Before any of these pending runs: public weapon durability <=18 with no ready backup triggers actual owned reserve-weapon offering through UI, removing at most one weakest public contaminant while retaining progress. Existing production ensureStarter may replace an exhausted weapon, recorded as base replacement not loot. Prepared-natural heavy requires ready weapon>=30, medium>=12. Cash/HP/growth/inventory not reset.
sourceSelection: First low-growth resumed actual return whose public ready weapon has >=30 remaining durability. No choice by income, outcome or seed; source storage hash to be appended when this condition first occurs.
